items.title: Binance CFO is leaving to ‘pursue a new venture’ after $6.3 billion hack
items.summary: The announcement comes barely more than a week after hackers stole $6.3 billion worth of cryptocurrency from Binance users.
items.creator: Anthony Ha

items.title: Amazon’s new basic Kindle proves you don’t need all the bells and whistles
items.summary: Amazon's redesigned basic Kindle costs more than before, but its lighter build and improved display make a compelling case for skipping the pricier models.
items.creator: Sarah Perez
